excerpt: Every scroll animation you have admired this year is a flipbook. The scrollbar is the thumb. John Barnes Linnett patented that in 1868 as the kineograph. Apple's AirPods Pro page ships it today at 2560x1440, and someone rebuilt it in a pen. Every frame already drawn, every frame already there, and the reader can stop on frame 41 and stare at it.
